name: @internal/figma-downloader-v300
description: Download a Figma file of any size (sm/md/large/xl/xxxxl) in chunks — skeleton-first, bounded-concurrency batched /nodes streamed to disk, byte/time-aware re-chunking, content-hash idempotent parts, typed errors, proxy/TLS config — and reconstruct a single full file JSON locally. Node ESM CLI over the workspace SDK (@internal/figma-api-fetch-file -> @internal/figma-api-fetch -> undici + zod). Output twin of the stdlib-only Python package in packages/py: byte-identical results enforced by packages/parity.

scripts.typecheck: node --check bin/figma-download.mjs && node --check src/cli.mjs && node --check src/chunk.mjs && node --check src/reconstruct.mjs && node --check src/util.mjs && node --check src/mock.mjs && node --check src/config.mjs && node --check src/errors.mjs
